sources.entry: Tome - Ebook and manga library server with web reader, OPDS and metadata fetching. A KOReader plugin records every reading session and syncs positions both ways, powering streaks, pace, heatmaps and per-book stats. (Source Code, Clients) AGPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: Tome is a self-hosted ebook and manga library server with a built-in web reader, OPDS feed, metadata fetching, and a custom KOReader plugin that records reading sessions and syncs positions.
keywords: sync reading position between device and browser
use_cases: Host a personal ebook and manga library and read it in the browser
Track reading sessions, streaks and pace from an e-reader
Sync reading position between KOReader and a web reader
Serve an OPDS catalog to e-reader apps
Fetch and compare book metadata from Hardcover, Google Books and OpenLibrary
Push ratings and progress to a Hardcover profile
how_to_run: Open the web UI in a browser and follow the setup wizard to create an admin account
Or clone the repo and run docker compose up -d using the canonical docker-compose.yml
notable: Custom KOReader plugin (TomeSync) records reading sessions and syncs positions both ways, including offline
Reading stats such as streaks, time-of-day heatmaps, pace and per-book breakdowns built from real session data
Built-in reader for EPUB, CBZ/CBR and PDF with two-page spread, RTL and webtoon modes
Bindery inbox for incoming books with metadata review before import
Optional OIDC single sign-on with group-to-role mapping
caveats: Full sync and stats features require TomeSync plugin on a current KOReader release (v2024.07 or newer)
README recommends running on an always-on host rather than a laptop for KOReader sync and OPDS
Telemetry is opt-in and update checks contact upgrades.bndct.dev daily unless disabled
Tome Reader iPhone app is closed source, in free beta until 31 December 2026, and optional
